project_type: Python 3.11 FastAPI-style backend (no API work in this task), DuckDB 2.0.0 file database, pandas/numpy/scipy; offline batch scripts
build_system: no build step; requirements.txt installed; pytest with pythonpath=['.']; ruff line-length 100 (select E,F,I,W; ignore E501). Run from d:/Data/backend with $env:PYTHONUTF8=1 in PowerShell.
test_framework: pytest 8.4 (marker `realdata` for tests on the real CSVs/DB)
build_command: python -m ruff check . ; python -m ruff format --check .
test_command: python -m pytest -q  (58 existing tests must keep passing, about 70 s)
verification_instructions: Per feature: run that feature's tests, run its script(s) on the real DB, load each output JSON with json.load, confirm preservation JSON/assert shows official CSV sha256 and official table content hashes unchanged. Final: pytest -q, ruff check, ruff format --check.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Outputs in d:/Data/backend/data/reports/: format_weight_sensitivity.json/.md, eligibility_distribution.json, eligibility_threshold_experiment.json, eligibility_threshold_report.md, cricsheet_super_over_validation.json/.md, data_quality_impact_report.json/.md, phase25_preservation.json. Config files in d:/Data/backend/config/: format_weights_v1.json, eligibility_rules_v1.json, data_quality_restrictions_v1.json. All generated by scripts in d:/Data/backend/scripts/.
environment_constraints: d:/Data is not a git repository: no commits, do not git init. Open the official DuckDB read-only for analysis; the only permitted write is the explicit `--register` option that inserts one model_versions row. Never modify CSVs, JSON data dirs, or official tables. Keep everything inside d:/Data. Lower-case d:/Data in paths. Cricsheet is validation-only: never load it into DuckDB tables. DuckDB cannot hold a read-write and a read-only connection to the same file in one process at once: close handles before registering. Do not run python3.
contribution_requirements: From phase2_user_summary.md and the user brief: preserve unresolved DQ issues; do not delete records or globally exclude matches; do not relabel innings 3/4 as Super Overs in official data; do not assume meanings for extras_type 'other' and 'Penalty'; every number in reports comes from code; every output has proxy_run=true and pressure_status=PENDING_PHASE3; deterministic and seeded; ruff and pytest clean.
key_patterns: app.core.database.connect(path, read_only=True) returns Database with query/scalar/execute; REPLACEABLE_TABLES lists official tables; app.utils.jsonio.write_json for JSON; tests build temp environments and compare sha256 before/after (tests/test_csv_ingestion.py); validation_service.py shows how DQ rows are created; cricsheet_auditor.normalise_team and _record/summarise_innings for Cricsheet parsing; staging index data/staging/cricsheet_index.parquet.
directory_structure: d:/Data/backend/app/{core,data_pipeline,services,utils} existing; NEW app/analytics and app/validation (add __init__.py); scripts/; tests/; config/ (NEW); data/{audit,database,staging,reports(NEW)}. Raw data (CSVs, *_male_json dirs) sit directly under d:/Data and are read-only.
